steps.text: Loads Microsoft's concrt140.dll, which the Visual C++ runtime a game installs puts in system32, instead of the copy built into Wine. The Wine 11 engines up to r29 carry an older concrt140 whose concurrent_vector can hand a program an address before the memory behind it exists when several threads add to it at once; upstream Wine fixed it in May 2026. Forza Horizon 6's build of November 3, 2026 crashed on it within a minute of starting. Without a Microsoft copy in the environment Wine's own is used, as before. It takes effect when the game starts again.

lastVerified.result: Forza Horizon 6 build 26261073 through Steam with its recipe's settings, cold starts of the environment: without the override it crashed in its first minute writing to 0x9 or 0x29 from forzahorizon6.exe+0xeb33ff, whose call to concrt140's _Internal_push_back returned Wine's SEGMENT_ALLOC_MARKER plus an offset, in 5 of 10 starts on r28 and every start on the r30 candidate. With concrt140=n,b, 3 of 3 on r28 and 3 of 3 on r30 reached the game's next screen.
